university.name: Shri Mata Vaishno Devi University
university.inauguratedBy: Dr. A.P.J Abdul Kalam, Hon'ble President of India
university.description: Shri Mata Vaishno Devi University was established under an Act of J&K State Legislature in 1999 as a fully residential and technical university, the first of its kind in J&K. Recognized by UGC under Section 2(f) & 12(B) of the UGC Act of 1956, the university receives funding from UGC.
university.campusDescription: The University is located on 470 acres of land in the lap of Trikuta Hills, the abode of Shri Mata Vaishno Devi at about 2700 feet above the sea level. The pyramidal type architecture merges beautifully with the valley like ambience of the surrounding serene hills. The surrounding green hills and the perennial stream of Jhajjar in the east minimize the effects of hot and cold winds and produce a pollution free atmosphere on the campus.
recognition: UGC under Section 2(F) & Section 12(B) of UGC Act of 1956
AICTE (All India Council of Technical Education) for technical programs
Council of Architecture for Architecture program
university.vision: Establishment of a Scientific & Technical University of Excellence to nurture young talented human resource for the service of Indian Society & World at large preserving the integrity and sanctity of human values.
university.mission: The Mission of the University is the pursuit of Education, Scholarship and Research and its application to the Society at highest International levels of excellence.
coreValues: Respect and Tolerance for the views of every Individual
Attention to issues of National relevance as well as of global concern
Appreciation of intellectual excellence and creativity

administration.chancellor: His Excellency the Lieutenant Governor of J&K, Sh. Manoj Sinha

university.logoDescription: The Design of the logo looks like a Lotus, a symbol of regeneration or a flame. The three green bars are symbolic representation of three holy peaks of Trikuta Hills and/or the three 'pindies' in Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Shrine. The Sun, the giver of Light, Warmth, Time, Direction, Life Force, Energy, Power, Radiance and Enlightenment have been shown surrounded by radiating rays going out to nine planets of the Solar System.

ekatva.name: EKATVA
ekatva.fullName: EKATVA — The Annual Techfest of SMVDU
ekatva.description: Ekatva is the annual techfest of Shri Mata Vaishno Devi University, nestled in the sacred hills of Katra, Jammu & Kashmir. For three electrifying days, students from across India converge to compete, innovate, and celebrate the spirit of technology — from intense hackathons and adrenaline-pumping RoboWars to cutting-edge AI workshops and immersive tech exhibitions.

nearestTouristPlaces.name: Vaishno Devi Temple
nearestTouristPlaces.description: One of the most revered Hindu temples dedicated to Goddess Vaishno Devi, nestled in the Trikuta Mountains at 5,200 feet.

nearestTouristPlaces.name: Patnitop Hill Station
nearestTouristPlaces.description: A scenic plateau at 2,024m altitude on the Jammu-Srinagar highway, offering panoramic views and adventure sports.

nearestTouristPlaces.name: Amar Palace
nearestTouristPlaces.description: Historic Amar Mahal Palace in Jammu, now a museum housing rare artifacts, paintings, and a golden throne.

howToReach.description: The university campus is located 14 km short of the holy town of Katra, and 40 km from Jammu. The campus is well-connected by Road, Rail & Air.
howToReach.byRoad: Well-connected via National Highway NH-44. Regular buses from Jammu, Delhi, and other cities.
howToReach.byRail: Nearest railway station: Katra (Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Katra Railway Station), 14 km away.
howToReach.byAir: Nearest airport: Jammu Airport (IXJ), approximately 50 km away.
